notes.text:
Omission of Vivakṣā and Direct Affix Selection (Known Shortcut)
Step: #37
Sūtras involved: 2.3.36 सप्तम्यधिकरणे च, 1.4.22 द्व्येकयोर्द्विवचनैकवचने.
Issue: Sūtra 4.1.2 only lists the affixes. To select ṅi, the engine must process semantic intent (Locative + Singular).
Classification: Ledgered shortcut. The UI bypasses the linguistic state rules and directly binds the affix based on user input.
notes.author: me
notes.verdict: Claude 2026-11-16 — Repeat of a stamped note; resolved, see S179 (the sup is chosen from (vibhakti, vacana) by the caller; 1.4.21/22 and 2.3.x do not fire as rows). No new work.
